case.name: pool-sharing-active

case.name: curve-legacy82
case.purpose: First nonzero guard; complete legacy typed minimum, no raw quote extension.

case.name: curve-zero-padded114
case.purpose: Second nonzero guard, one byte below full extension; fallback WSOL.

case.name: curve-exact115-nonnative
case.purpose: Third nonzero guard; exactly complete 83:115 quote range copies fixed synthetic pubkey.

case.name: curve200-zero-quote
case.purpose: Full padding with zero quote maps to WSOL.

case.name: curve200-explicit-wsol
case.purpose: Explicit WSOL is preserved.

case.name: curve200-nonnative
case.purpose: Non-native metadata is preserved; no quote-token transfer/account or market claim.

case.name: curve-sharing-active-nonnative
case.purpose: Curve selected creator converges on shared authorization; output creator is AUTH admin.

case.name: curve-virtual-token-only
case.purpose: Fourth and final nonzero guard; synthetic selector boundary, not historical economic state.

case.name: existing-valid-noop
case.purpose: Existing version7 state remains byte-identical; exact already-exists log; no creation event.
